messages.author: e4c3fc328ba9081e
messages.subject: Re: Error in compareGroups function whenever I try to use the survival analysis in the GUI
parts:
Once your data is loaded, you have to select the response variable by clicking on 'SETTINGS' tab from left side panel and select 'Survival' in the 'Response type' submenu. Then, introduce 'time' and 'status' in 'Select time-to-event variable' and 'Select status variable' fields, respectively. And, choose '1' category as indicator code of event. Finaly, click on 'TABLE' tab to visualize the bivariate table. Note that p-values are computed properly, performing a log-rank test or a Cox-regression.
Please, let us know if your problem persists, and, if not, please send us the data to reproduce your example to the compareGroups R-package mantainer e-mail.
Regards,
Isaac.
